about: Key-encryption keys (HKDF-SHA256, 32 bytes) of the vault's unlock entries. enclave: ikm = Z (the P-256 ECDH secret of the entry's ephemeral key and the Secure Enclave key, 32 bytes) ‖ shellSecret (32), salt = ephPub ‖ sePub (X9.63 uncompressed, 65 bytes each), info "vault-unlock enclave". hello: ikm = the Windows Hello RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature of the challenge ‖ shellSecret, salt = challenge (32), info "vault-unlock hello". prf: ikm = the WebAuthn PRF output (first, 32 bytes), salt = the entry's PRF salt (32), info "vault-unlock prf". All base64url without padding. sePriv and ephPriv are given only to check Z.
